prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Presenting complaints included right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion with forward elevation and abduction, and pain with overhead reaching and lifting. Initial examination noted tenderness over the anterior shoulder, positive impingement signs, and guarding with active movement. Imaging was reviewed and no acute fracture was identified; findings were consistent with soft tissue injury to the rotator cuff and surrounding musculature.

Conservative management was initiated and consisted of a structured physical therapy program over the course of 30 visits, including manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion exercises, rotator cuff strengthening, and postural education. Anti-inflammatory medication and activity modification were used as adjuncts. Progress was steady, with gradual improvement in pain scores, active range of motion, and functional tolerance for daily activities.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported significant but incomplete recovery. Residual mild weakness with resisted overhead movement and intermittent discomfort with heavy lifting remain. Continued home exercise program and activity restrictions were recommended, with reassessment if symptoms persist or worsen.
